from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from cold_prefill_tail_build_evidence_r1 import validate_build
from native_mtp_prefix_runtime_prerequisites_r1 import validate_prerequisites

read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()
assert socket.gethostname().split('.')[0].lower() != 'baiying'
mp = B / 'cold-tail-native-mtp-source-r1.json'
m = read(mp)
case = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) == 2 else None
assert case in m['case_names'], 'Specify one frozen native MTP retirement case'
c = next(c for c in m['cases'] if c['name'] == case)
active_dir = B / m['active_directory']
active = active_dir / 'run-record.json'
if not active.is_file():
    raise SystemExit('The full256k native task is still active; no remote action was attempted.')
r = read(active)
assert r['host'].lower() == 'baiying'
assert r['host_checks_pass'] and all(r['host_checks'].values()) and not r['after_processes']
assert sha(active_dir / 'launch.json') == m['active_launch_sha256']
active_analysis = active_dir / 'boundary-analysis.json'
assert isinstance(read(active_analysis), dict)
for key in ('script', 'dispatcher', 'analyzer', 'profile', 'build_evidence_helper', 'prerequisite_helper'):
    assert sha(B / m[key]) == m[key + '_sha256']
assert sha(B / m['guard']['file']) == m['guard']['sha256']
build = validate_build()
assert build['source_manifest_sha256'] == m['build_source_manifest_sha256']
prerequisites = validate_prerequisites(m['native_prerequisites'])
controls, uploads = [], []


def stage(local, remote):
    destination = B / remote.rsplit('/', 1)[1]
    if destination.exists():
        assert sha(destination) == sha(local)
    else:
        with destination.open('xb') as f:
            f.write(local.read_bytes())
    uploads.append(str(destination))


active_analysis_remote = 'D:/projects/cold-tail-native-mtp-active-full256k-analysis-r1.json'
stage(active_analysis, active_analysis_remote)
for item in prerequisites:
    stage(Path(item['comparison_local']), item['comparison_remote'])
if c['retirement_required']:
    for name in ('q7169-out32', 'q8192-out512', 'q8191-out32', 'q8193-out32'):
        directory = B / ('cold-tail-native-mtp-' + name + '-r1')
        analysis = directory / 'boundary-analysis.json'
        if not analysis.is_file():
            raise SystemExit('Same-source native short control is not qualified: ' + name + '; no remote action was attempted.')
        proof, run = read(analysis), read(directory / 'run-record.json')
        assert proof['qualified'] and proof['source_commit'] == m['source_commit'] and proof['build'] == build
        assert proof['source_manifest_sha256'] == sha(mp) and run['reason'] == 'completed' and run['exit_code'] == 0
        assert run['host_checks_pass'] and all(run['host_checks'].values()) and not run['after_processes']
        remote = 'D:/projects/' + directory.name + '-boundary-analysis.json'
        stage(analysis, remote)
        controls.append(dict(case=name, analysis_remote=remote, analysis_sha256=sha(analysis),
            run_path=m['repo'] + '/build/' + directory.name + '/run-record.json', run_sha256=sha(directory / 'run-record.json')))

data = B / m['local_reference_directory']
assert sha(data / 'manifest.json') == m['reference_data']['manifest_sha256']
for name, entry in read(data / 'manifest.json').items():
    assert (data / name).stat().st_size == entry['bytes'] and sha(data / name) == entry['sha256']
stem = 'cold-tail-native-mtp-' + case
binding = B / (stem + '-binding-r1.json')
with binding.open('x') as f:
    json.dump(dict(source_manifest_sha256=sha(mp), active_run_sha256=sha(active),
        active_boundary_remote=active_analysis_remote, active_boundary_sha256=sha(active_analysis),
        build=build, native_prerequisites=prerequisites, short_controls=controls, case=case), f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
d = B / (stem + '-r1')
d.mkdir()
opts = ['-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=10']
subprocess.run(['scp', *opts, str(mp), str(binding), str(B / m['script']), str(B / m['profile']),
    str(B / m['guard']['file']), *uploads, 'baiying:D:/projects/'], check=True, timeout=60)
subprocess.run(['scp', *opts, '-r', str(data), 'baiying:D:/projects/'], check=True, timeout=60)
command = ['ssh', *opts, 'baiying', 'powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:/projects/' + m['script'] + ' -Case ' + case]
start = time.monotonic()
try:
    p = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=c['transport_timeout_seconds'])
    record = dict(command=command, returncode=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout, stderr=p.stderr, wall_seconds=time.monotonic() - start)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
    record = dict(command=command, returncode=None, timeout=True, stdout=str(e.stdout), stderr=str(e.stderr), wall_seconds=time.monotonic() - start)
    with (d / 'dispatch.json').open('x') as f:
        json.dump(record, f, indent=2)
        f.write('\n')
    raise
with (d / 'dispatch.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
transfers = []
for name in ('run-record.json', 'preflight.json', 'launch.json', 'telemetry.jsonl', 'product.stdout.jsonl', 'product.stderr.log', 'runtime.env'):
    t = subprocess.run(['scp', *opts, 'baiying:' + m['repo'] + '/build/' + d.name + '/' + name, str(d / name)],
        capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=45)
    transfers.append(dict(file=name, returncode=t.returncode, stderr=t.stderr))
with (d / 'transfers.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(transfers, f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
assert all(t['returncode'] == 0 for t in transfers)
r = read(d / 'run-record.json')
print(json.dumps({k: r[k] for k in ('reason', 'exit_code', 'wall_ms', 'host_checks_pass')}), flush=True)
if p.returncode:
    print(record['stderr'][-1200:] + (d / 'product.stderr.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-1200:], flush=True)

"""Judge actual native/retired rows by GB10 tokens and comparable logits."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re
import struct
import sys

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()


def analyze_tokens(case, expected, records, lines):
    of_type = lambda kind: [r for r in records if r.get('type') == kind]
    markers = lambda name: [dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)=([^ ]+)', line)) for line in lines if line.startswith('BATCH_MARK ' + name + ' ')]
    summaries = of_type('summary')
    result = summaries[0] if len(summaries) == 1 else {}
    callbacks = of_type('token')
    tokens = markers('qwen36_native_mtp_token')
    ordinary = markers('qwen36_whole_provider_resident_decode_token')
    completed = markers('qwen36_native_mtp_decode_complete')
    retired = markers('qwen36_native_mtp_retired_target')
    seeds = markers('qwen36_mtp_native_request_seed')
    chunks = markers('qwen36_chunked_prefill_chunk')
    chunk_complete = markers('qwen36_chunked_prefill_complete')
    number = lambda t, k: int(t.get(k, -1))
    finite_logit = lambda value, expected: isinstance(value, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(value) and abs(value - expected) <= 0.125
    n, native_count = case['input_tokens'], len(tokens)
    actual = result.get('output_token_ids', [])
    row_boundary = lambda ts: [(number(t, 'position'), number(t, 'input_token'), number(t, 'output_token')) for t in ts]
    wanted = [(n + i, expected[i], expected[i + 1]) for i in range(len(expected) - 1)]
    checks = dict(
        original_prompt=result.get('prompt_token_ids_fnv1a64') == case['prompt_fnv1a64'] and result.get('input_tokens') == n,
        original_outputs=actual == expected and result.get('status') == 'pass',
        original_first_logit=finite_logit(result.get('first_token_raw_logit'), case['first_logit']),
        actual_native_seed=len(seeds) == 1 and number(seeds[0], 'processed_tokens') == n and
            seeds[0].get('exact_target_frontier') == '1' and seeds[0].get('immutable_checkpoint') == '1',
        native_commits=0 < native_count <= len(expected) - 1 and all(t.get('reference_input') == '0' and
            t.get('target_and_drafter_committed') == '1' and number(t, 'accepted_rows') in (1, 2) for t in tokens),
        native_token_boundaries=row_boundary(tokens) == wanted[:native_count],
        exact_callbacks=[(c.get('index'), c.get('token_id'), c.get('phase')) for c in callbacks] ==
            [(i, t, 'prefill' if i == 0 else 'decode') for i, t in enumerate(expected)],
        callback_clocks=bool(callbacks) and all(c.get('step_ms', 0) > 0 for c in callbacks) and
            all(a['request_elapsed_ms'] < z['request_elapsed_ms'] for a, z in zip(callbacks, callbacks[1:])),
        public_stream_contract=result.get('stream_callback_count') == len(expected) and
            result.get('callbacks_before_return') is True and result.get('stream_matches_output') is True,
        no_diagnostic_seed_files=not any('qwen36_mtp_native_prefill_probe ' in line for line in lines),
        completed_native_spans=bool(completed) and sum(number(c, 'accepted_tokens') for c in completed) == native_count and
            all(c.get('paired_checkpoint') == '1' and c.get('reference_input') == '0' for c in completed))
    observed, groups = {}, []
    if case['retirement_required']:
        index, valid_groups = 0, True
        while index < native_count:
            count = number(tokens[index], 'accepted_rows')
            if count not in (1, 2) or index + count > native_count:
                valid_groups = False
                break
            group = tokens[index:index + count]
            first = number(group[0], 'position')
            valid_groups = valid_groups and all(number(t, 'accepted_rows') == count and
                number(t, 'position') == first + row for row, t in enumerate(group))
            groups.append(dict(first_position=first, accepted_rows=count, scheduled_rows=2))
            for row, t in enumerate(group):
                observed[(number(t, 'position'), 2, row)] = t
            index += count
        for t in ordinary:
            observed[(number(t, 'position'), 1, 0)] = t
        checks.update(
            native_pair_groups=valid_groups and bool(groups) and len(completed) == 1 and number(completed[0], 'target_batches') == len(groups),
            scheduled_retirement=bool(groups) and groups[-1]['first_position'] + 2 >= 262144 and
                all(g['first_position'] + 2 < 262144 for g in groups[:-1]),
            actual_retired_receipt=len(retired) == 1 and native_count < len(expected) - 1 and
                number(retired[0], 'first_position') == n + native_count and
                number(retired[0], 'accepted_tokens') == len(expected) - 1 - native_count and
                number(retired[0], 'processed_tokens') == n + len(expected) - 1 and
                retired[0].get('drafter_retired') == '1' and retired[0].get('target_rows') == '1' and retired[0].get('reference_input') == '0',
            ordinary_token_boundaries=row_boundary(ordinary) == wanted[native_count:],
            final_checkpoint_retired=len(completed) == 1 and completed[0].get('drafter_retired') == '1',
            actual_cold_chunks=[tuple(number(c, key) for key in ('index', 'first_position', 'input_tokens', 'history_tokens', 'sampled_to_caller')) for c in chunks] ==
                [(i, start, min(8192, n - start), min(start + 8192, n), 0) for i, start in enumerate(range(0, n, 8192))],
            complete_cold_owner=len(chunk_complete) == 1 and number(chunk_complete[0], 'input_tokens') == n and
                number(chunk_complete[0], 'chunks') == 32 and number(chunk_complete[0], 'first_token') == expected[0] and
                finite_logit(float(chunk_complete[0].get('raw_logit', 'nan')), case['first_logit']))
    else:
        checks['complete_native_short_route'] = (native_count == len(expected) - 1 and not ordinary and not retired and
            all(c.get('drafter_retired') == '0' for c in completed))
    if n > 8192 and not case['retirement_required']:
        checks['actual_cold_tail_chunks'] = ([tuple(number(c, key) for key in ('index', 'first_position', 'input_tokens', 'history_tokens', 'sampled_to_caller')) for c in chunks] ==
            [(i, start, min(8192, n - start), min(start + 8192, n), 0) for i, start in enumerate(range(0, n, 8192))])
        checks['completed_cold_tail'] = (len(chunk_complete) == 1 and number(chunk_complete[0], 'input_tokens') == n and
            number(chunk_complete[0], 'chunks') == (n + 8191) // 8192 and number(chunk_complete[0], 'first_token') == expected[0] and
            finite_logit(float(chunk_complete[0].get('raw_logit', 'nan')), case['first_logit']))
    compared, incomparable = [], []
    for row in case['original_decode_logit_rows']:
        key = (row['position'], row['scheduled_rows'], row['row'])
        value = observed.get(key)
        if value is None:
            incomparable.append(row)
            continue
        logit = float(value.get('output_logit', 'nan'))
        passed = number(value, 'input_token') == row['input_token'] and number(value, 'output_token') == row['output_token'] and finite_logit(logit, row['output_logit'])
        compared.append(dict(**row, actual_logit=logit if math.isfinite(logit) else None, passed=passed))
    if case['retirement_required']:
        checks['same_layout_original_decode_logits'] = (bool(compared) and all(row['passed'] for row in compared) and
            {row['scheduled_rows'] for row in compared} == {1, 2})
    return dict(checks=checks, token_boundary_qualified=all(checks.values()), first_token=actual[0] if actual else None,
        first_logit=result.get('first_token_raw_logit'), native_output_count=len(actual), callback_count=len(callbacks),
        first_difference=next((dict(index=i, actual=a, expected=z) for i, (a, z) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected)) if a != z), None),
        native_target_commits=native_count, ordinary_target_commits=len(ordinary), native_pair_groups=groups,
        native_seeds=seeds, native_spans=completed, retired_target_spans=retired,
        comparable_original_decode_logits=compared, different_layout_original_rows=incomparable,
        observed_timing={k: result.get(k) for k in ('engine_load_ms', 'ttft_ms', 'tpot_ms', 'request_wall_ms')})


def main():
    from cold_prefill_tail_build_evidence_r1 import validate_build
    from native_mtp_prefix_runtime_prerequisites_r1 import validate_prerequisites
    mp = B / 'cold-tail-native-mtp-source-r1.json'
    m = read(mp)
    name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) == 2 else None
    assert name in m['case_names']
    case = next(c for c in m['cases'] if c['name'] == name)
    stem = 'cold-tail-native-mtp-' + name
    d = B / (stem + '-r1')
    build = validate_build()
    run, binding = read(d / 'run-record.json'), read(B / (stem + '-binding-r1.json'))
    spec = run['spec']
    assert spec['source_manifest_sha256'] == binding['source_manifest_sha256'] == sha(mp)
    assert spec['build'] == binding['build'] == build and run['host'].lower() == 'baiying'
    assert spec['repo_commit'] == m['source_commit'] == build['source_commit']
    assert spec['command_file_sha256'] == m['script_sha256'] and spec['environment_sha256'] == m['profile_sha256'] == sha(d / 'runtime.env')
    assert read(d / 'preflight.json')['executable_sha256'] == m['plain_cli']['sha256']
    assert spec['dependency_files'] == m['dependency_files'] and spec['reference_data'] == m['reference_data']
    assert spec['original_case'] == case and spec['original_contract'] == m['original_contract']
    assert spec['guard_sha256'] == m['guard']['sha256'] == sha(B / m['guard']['file'])
    assert read(d / 'launch.json')['timeout_seconds'] == case['native_timeout_seconds']
    for key in ('script', 'dispatcher', 'analyzer', 'profile', 'build_evidence_helper', 'prerequisite_helper'):
        assert sha(B / m[key]) == m[key + '_sha256']
    prerequisites = validate_prerequisites(m['native_prerequisites'])
    assert spec['native_prerequisites'] == binding['native_prerequisites'] == prerequisites
    assert spec['case'] == binding['case'] == name and spec['native_mtp_decode_enabled'] is True
    assert spec['short_controls'] == binding['short_controls']
    assert len(binding['short_controls']) == (4 if case['retirement_required'] else 0)
    data = B / m['local_reference_directory']
    assert sha(data / 'manifest.json') == m['reference_data']['manifest_sha256']
    for filename, entry in read(data / 'manifest.json').items():
        assert (data / filename).stat().st_size == entry['bytes'] and sha(data / filename) == entry['sha256']
    prompt, expected = read(data / (name + '-prompt.json')), read(data / (name + '-expected.json'))
    assert len(prompt) == case['input_tokens'] and len(expected) == case['outputs']
    assert hashlib.sha256(struct.pack('<' + 'I' * len(prompt), *prompt)).hexdigest() == case['prompt_u32le_sha256']
    assert sha(Path(case['original_source']['file'])) == case['original_source']['sha256']
    records = []
    for line in (d / 'product.stdout.jsonl').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
        if line.startswith('{'):
            row = json.loads(line)
            if isinstance(row, dict):
